_sources: WGS84 [lat, lng] for the day maps Add-RouteMaps draws in route boxes (18 Nov 2026). Keyed by journal slug, then the day's section number (trip-section-N), then the stop's English name as written in the route. Points come from OpenStreetMap (Nominatim and Overpass; OSM ids in _notes), cross-checked against Wikidata P625 where it has one; never from Amap, Baidu or Tencent, which use GCJ-02 (about 500 m off). Every stop on a listed day needs an entry (the build fails otherwise); null marks one with no published point: the massage shop (no reputable listing) and the River View Homestay (a private address). An optional third value is a short place name drawn beside the pin for context (the town, the mountain); keep them to one or two a day.
